lab.title: Lesson 1.1 — First Contact
lab.blurb: Connect Astro's console to Rivet's workbench so the crew can talk.

steps.title: Give each console an address
steps.body: Astro's console and Rivet's workbench are both cabled to the ship's relay switch, but neither has an address yet, so neither can be found. Double-click each device to open its terminal and give each one an address from 192.168.1.0/24, for example `ip addr add 192.168.1.10/24 dev eth0` on astro and `ip addr add 192.168.1.20/24 dev eth0` on rivet. Check your work with `ip addr`.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.body: From astro, run `ping -c 3` followed by rivet's address. Success means Rivet's workbench answers Astro's console. Then press Check objectives.
